comparison.objective: Carry an intact three-box stack onto a shelf in one trip; not partition mixed objects by size.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual whole-stack compression and transport versus controlled agitation that intentionally moves media relative to the held screen.
comparison.success_condition: Stack never separates or exceeds slide/tilt limits and ends standing on the shelf.
comparison.reason: Although both share bimanual load support, the tested abilities and required internal motion are opposite.
